description: A path point is the geometry of the final approach segment of an approach that uses satellite navigation. It has the landing threshold point (LTP), the flight path alignment point (FPAP), the glide path angle and the threshold crossing height (TCH).

$schema.description: This field identifies the schema that validates this document.

airfield.description: This field identifies the airfield of this record. An example is `kden`.

approach.description: This field identifies the approach procedure. An example is `R16RY`.

approach_type.description: This field gives the published type of the approach, for example `LPV` or `LP`.

course_width_at_threshold.description: This field gives the course width at the landing threshold point (LTP), as a length with its unit. It is the lateral distance from the course centreline at which full-scale deflection occurs.

extensions.description: This field contains extension data in groups. The namespace of each group identifies the application or standard that supplies its data. The group `sim` contains the simulator data of the record.

final_approach_course.description: This field gives the final approach course, as a bearing with its unit and reference.

flight_path_alignment_point.description: This field gives the geographic position of the flight path alignment point (FPAP), as latitude and longitude. With the landing threshold point (LTP), this point gives the direction of the final approach course.

glide_path_angle_deg.description: This field gives the angle between the glide path and a horizontal line, in degrees.

id.description: This field identifies this path point. Other resources and orders use this stable identifier to refer to this path point.

kind.description: The value identifies this record as a path point record. The value selects this navigation contract.

landing_threshold_elevation.description: This field gives the orthometric height of the landing threshold point (LTP) above mean sea level, as an elevation with its unit.

landing_threshold_point.description: This field gives the geographic position of the landing threshold point (LTP), as latitude and longitude. The path of the final approach goes above this point at the threshold crossing height.

name.description: This field gives the name of this path point, for display.

provenance.description: This field gives the provenance of this path point as structured data: how the data were made, the authority, the aeronautical information regulation and control (AIRAC) cycle and the tool that made them.

resources_ref.description: This field identifies the resource catalogue that resolves the references of this path point. The reference gives the identifier and the revision of the catalogue.

runway.description: This field gives the designator of the runway of the approach.

source.description: This field gives the source of this record. The value gives the authority that publishes the data, and the cycle, for example `FAA CIFP cycle 2610`. A record that an author writes does not have this field. The field `provenance` gives the same facts as structured data.

threshold_crossing_height.description: This field gives the threshold crossing height (TCH) of the path of the final approach, as a length with its unit. It is the height of the path of the final approach above the landing threshold point (LTP).

title: Path point
